purpose: Segment 41 short-window/MFA recovery and a real cooperative file lock. Offline reference does not load models. Not a full-chain pass.
input_identity: fixed baseline transcript segment_000041; raw text is recorded only as a difference
allowed_variable: REAL_ALIGN_RECOVERY_MODE=real loads one GPU model at a time and MFA; unset is offline
failure_policy: release the lock in finally; keep the host result; no retries
cache_policy: python -B; no bytecode in the legacy repository

permissions.write: new runs/experiments/<id> evidence, REAL-ALIGN-RECOVERY-001 workdir, or session scratch
permissions.read: legacy transcript/audio/MFA resources and the existing model cache

oracle: offline host evidence is the replay reference; real segment comparison is reported separately and is not a full-chain pass
